settings.devices.title: Devices
settings.devices.subtitle: Pair phones and tablets to control AWOG remotely over your Tailscale network.
settings.devices.enable.name: Remote control
settings.devices.enable.desc: Let paired devices reach this machine over your Tailscale network. While this is off, AWOG opens no port at all.
settings.devices.offHint: Nothing is listening on the network. Turn it on to pair a device and control sessions from your phone; turning it back off disconnects every paired device immediately.
settings.devices.tailnetDisconnected: Tailscale not detected — remote control is off
settings.devices.installHint: Install and sign in to Tailscale on this machine, then reopen this panel. Devices on the same tailnet will be able to pair.
settings.devices.guide.title: How to set up Tailscale
settings.devices.guide.step1: Install Tailscale on this machine and sign in:
settings.devices.guide.step2: Install the Tailscale app on your phone (App Store / Google Play) and sign in with the same account.
settings.devices.guide.step3: Make sure both devices show "Connected" in Tailscale (same tailnet).
settings.devices.guide.step4: Come back here — the badge turns to "Tailscale connected". Tap "Pair new device" and scan the QR with your phone.
settings.devices.guide.tip: Your phone doesn't need the same Wi-Fi — Tailscale connects it even over cellular (4G/5G).
settings.devices.scanHint: Scan this QR code with your device, or enter the code below manually.
settings.devices.pair.title: Pair a device
settings.devices.confirmRevoke.title: Revoke device
settings.devices.confirmRevoke.body: "{label}" will lose access immediately and must pair again to reconnect.
settings.devices.pairFailed: Could not create a pairing code: {error}
settings.devices.empty.title: No devices paired yet
settings.devices.empty.body: Pair a phone or tablet to drive AWOG sessions from anywhere on your tailnet.
settings.devices.access.title: Access address
settings.devices.access.hint: A paired device reopens AWOG Remote at this address — no re-pairing needed.
settings.devices.access.qrHint: Scan with the phone camera to reopen the app (this code carries no pairing code).
